text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(There was a back I had always been 
watching.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“My debut race was at Kyoto Turf 1400m, 
where Sweep Tosho also ran.”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"The strong Umamusume are the ones who 
win." To run in the same race as the 
senior who taught everyone that obvious, 
yet unthinkable truth.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"And she also ran in the Hanshin JF. 
Following in the footsteps of the seniors 
who demonstrated the speed and sheer 
determination of a Tiara Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
After that, I also ran in the Fillies' 
Revue. Drawn by my admiration for 
Ramonu-san, who was the first to show the 
true brilliance of the 'Triple Tiara.'

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I even ran in the Oka Sho, the first race 
of my dream Tiara route! Back then... do 
you think I was able to be like Dober-san?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I was always running while watching the 
backs of the seniors who forged their own 
paths."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: And now—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Craft. Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now, off you go. Go to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (I ran in front of that back.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Did you enjoy yourselves? Did 
your hearts race?

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"I had a blast~!! It was the best! Please 
do it again next year, toooo!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, right?! I think so too! Next year 
and beyond— I hope races like this keep 
happening!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...That is why we dream through the 
Umamusume who carry on our hopes and 
feelings."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Asking me to show her this scenery 
again someday.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
To answer that wish, we will leave 
something behind.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I will remain—without fail.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, yes. You're just so dazzling, I can 
hardly bear it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's why we can't stop reaching out. Our 
hearts throb with the urge to follow after 
her.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll never give up. One day, I'll make you 
watch my back from behind.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"So look forward to it. The birth of a new 
queen."
